raw_representation: Preserve all32 bits; this field is an integer percentage, without /4096.

stat_override.rule: Setter dispatch narrows stat ID to u8, then case26 copies all32 supplied value bits to runtime+760, without TPS/fixed-point/byte conversion.

level_multiplier.index: raw instance level byte; only level1 skips the table
level_multiplier.variable_rule: Type65 handler stores low16(ValueRaw) at0x6F261D +2*(statID*9 +level)+2. For stat26 this equals0x6F2550+0x2A3+2*level.

arithmetic.gate: Only while Creeping flag1000 is set; otherwise incoming metric bits unchanged.
arithmetic.metric: XY signed32 coordinate differences wrap32. Each signed64 square is shifted right12 and narrowed32; the two terms add modulo2^32. This is squared distance in Q12.
arithmetic.percentage: Level1: runtime DWORD bits. Other level bytes: trunc_to_zero(s32(low32(s16(levelMultiplier) * s32(rawPercentage)))/100).
arithmetic.weight: weighted = unsigned32(low32(incomingMetric * effectivePercentage)) //100. Low32 product occurs BEFORE the unsigned division.
arithmetic.bounds: No clamp to0..100 or nonnegative values in these fragments. Value0 produces metric0 when active.
arithmetic.sight: A later numeric sight gate compares signed32(metric) < signed32(low32(radiusTiles*radiusTiles*4096)); equality is rejected.
arithmetic.scope: Other faction, list, status, class-weight, nearest-candidate and LOS gates are outside this arithmetic projection.

separate_movement_speed.scope: First-person input selects speed mode2 when Creeping. Inspected speed helper selects runtime5BC, not EE4/runtime760. Other health/terrain/possession modifiers still apply.

action.rule: If player possessed-creature WORD+134 is nonzero: flags=(flags & FFFFEFFF) | ((actionDWORD0 &1)<<12). Otherwise flags unchanged. Other state bits preserved.

native_editor.load: When presence nonzero, callback stores low8 of raw DWORD in model byte. Native converter sets presence for a complete record.
native_editor.display: Property F85C reads model/panel as unsigned byte and presents it numerically.
native_editor.update: After __ftol, update case stores low8 of its integer result. No full GUI float parser or validation range is claimed.
native_editor.write: Writer zeros ECX, loads model byte into CL, stores full ECX DWORD. Present-field callback -> save projection is raw &255, including an unchanged property.
native_editor.preservation: An independent editor should retain all32 original bits unless an explicit user edit or native-compatibility normalization is requested.

limitations: Exact inspected EXE hashes only; no full-game behavioral or rendering validation.
Kernels receive a precomputed metric and explicit level multiplier. Entry TEST adapter supplies the skipped Creeping flags condition; f1/f2 receive the original cached metric slot.
Game pipeline chains original converter/loader fragments. Editor pipeline chains original callback/writer fragments; external construction, UI dispatch and resource loading skipped.
Other previously unknown Creatures fields and the four Terrain/Traps/Objects scalars are not assigned new semantics by this result.
Third-party template labels were leads; native debug text, PE resource, exact instructions and emulations establish the reported meaning.
